sources.supports: deleteSection validates the section ID, appends soft=1 only when the soft option is true, resolves with no value after a deletion and with the parsed preview after a soft request. The driver documents soft mode as TestRail 6.5 or later.
SoftDeletePreviewSchema describes the affected_tests, affected_cases, affected_sections, affected_runs, affected_milestones, affected_plans and affected_suites counts, each optional.

delete_section/{section_id} deletes the section with its cases and active tests and results and cannot be undone. Omitting soft or sending soft=0 deletes; soft=1 returns the affected counts and deletes nothing.

input_policy.notes: Strictness is an MCP boundary requirement. No body is sent; the only control is the soft preview flag, and any other query key is a caller mistake.

outer_result.notes: After a deletion the method resolves with no value and the wrapper reports data: null. After a preview it resolves with TestRail's affected-entity counts, which vary by TestRail version and are not drift-checked against an entity schema; every count is optional in the driver's schema, so an empty reply to soft=1 is reported as an empty preview rather than as an error. Previews need TestRail 6.5 or later. Deletion removes the section's subsections, cases and active tests and results with it.

requirements.description: Reject unknown top-level fields before driver invocation rather than forwarding or discarding them.
Reject an unsupported query key rather than discarding it.
Send exactly one request. The adapter never follows up with additional calls to enumerate or clean up what the deletion removed.

parameters.semantics: No coercion. The validated number is passed positionally and appears verbatim in the path.

wire.encoding: Decimal integer path segment; numeric strings are rejected rather than coerced.

parameters.semantics: true requests TestRail's server-side preview: the affected counts are returned and nothing is deleted. false or omitted deletes. An explicit false is accepted but never sent, since the driver only ever emits soft=1; TestRail documents soft=0 and an absent soft as equivalent.

wire.encoding: soft=1 appended path-style when true; nothing is appended when false or omitted.

requirements.description: Preserve the value as the soft option at driver argument 1.
Accept true, send soft=1 and return the preview counts.
Accept an explicit false, delete, and append nothing to the endpoint.
Reject a numeric stand-in for the boolean before driver invocation.
Delete, sending no soft control, when the caller did not supply one.
